body.statement: For \(P\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{joint}}(P)\), conditional on proving \(\mathrm{oeq:score-lifting-completeness}\), the observed joint-bridge functional \(\theta\) is pathwise differentiable if and only if \(\Phi_P\neq\varnothing\). Whenever this holds, every gradient lies in \(\mathcal A_P\) and \[\phi_{\mathrm{eff}}=\phi_0-\Pi_{\mathcal C_P}\phi_0=\operatorname*{argmin}_{\varphi\in\mathcal A_P}E[\varphi^2],\qquad V_{\mathrm{eff}}(P)=\inf_{\varphi\in\mathcal A_P}E[\varphi^2].\] The claim is not unconditional: the projection becomes the canonical gradient only after the reverse score-lifting inclusion is established.
body.justification: The conditional Hilbert projection is the intended general efficiency result.
body.gap: Its tangent-lifting and unbounded-product score-validity premises remain unresolved.
body.consumer: Analysts must use the unconditional finite results or state these conditions explicitly.

obligation.what_is_open: Establish the theorem's general pathwise differentiability equivalence and canonical-gradient conclusion on the repaired chart.
obligation.obstruction: The score-lifting dependency remains open. In addition, separate square integrability of the bridge functions and outcome does not control products involving moving bridge representatives, so the derivative identity for every unbounded-support DQM path cannot be obtained by silently differentiating a selected bridge.
obligation.attempted: The exact doubly robust remainder was expanded using nearby outcome and treatment bridges. Closed-range continuity yields nearby representatives but, without a product-stability argument, does not make the quadratic remainder little-o of the path parameter. The Hilbert projection step itself is complete once score validity and tangent equality are available.
obligation.partial_result:
If one has both \(\mathcal T_P=\mathcal C_P^\perp\) and a square-integrable bridge score \(\phi_0\) representing every path derivative of \(\theta\), Hilbert geometry gives
\[
\mathcal A_P=\phi_0+\mathcal C_P,qquad
\phi_{\mathrm{eff}}=\phi_0-\Pi_{\mathcal C_P}\phi_0,qquad
V_{\mathrm{eff}}=\|\phi_{\mathrm{eff}}\|_2^2.
\]
This conclusion is unconditional on the three proved positive finite germs.  The general existence-only chart still lacks a proved pathwise bridge-score differentiation theorem on its unbounded product domain and the reverse score-lifting conclusion.
